positions.as_written: Expect a combined injury to distribute load differently from the sectioning studies.
Treat the primary and secondary language as the framework for deciding what a reconstruction has to include.
Decide whether to augment by asking which share is not being restored.
Assess the secondary restraints before relying on a single graft to carry rotation.
Measure slope where the restraint is meeting an excessive load.
Read construct comparisons with the sectioning order limitation in mind.
